source.sourceReviewMethod: reviewCopperPadCenterCandidates from the task-scoped source branch
source.sourceMethodKind: pure read-only candidate screen; no public MCP tool integration

interpretationLimits: Scale and Y-axis mapping were explored from native source geometry but have not been independently accepted or calibrated. No physical distance or connectivity is asserted.

EasyEDA complex polygons encode one outer boundary followed by inner holes. The pad-center location in a native cutout is an observation about the sampled center point, not proof of actual pad-edge metal isolation.
Pad shapes and plated-through barrels may contact a poured region through footprints or narrow thermal ties that do not contain the pad center. No such contact graph was computed.
ARC discretization is bounded and approximate; border-adjacent candidate points require separate conservative tolerance and native acceptance.
One filled copper region and 73 fill=false records do not imply 74 conductive areas.
Native getter operations are version-sensitive/beta and the multiple read calls do not form an atomic snapshot.
No DRC clearance, return-current path, impedance, layer-stackup, thermal/current rating or manufacturing readiness was proven.
No native PCB mutation, copper rebuild, save, export, fabrication/supplier sendout, or provider support outreach took place.
